Standalone Python/FastAPI routing with SQLite event metadata, configurable FAST/SAFE model endpoints, and offline product-scoped SIG1 Ed25519 license verification. A compatible model endpoint is required. Synthetic demo, not measured performance.

Local-first source-linked pricing observations, human review, SQLite history, CSV export and SHA-256 comparison receipts. A content hash does not certify a vendor price.
